title: Repeat Reinstatement Surcharge in the Summit Program
content:
**Question: does the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program charge more when miles have been reinstated before?**

Yes. A repeat surcharge follows the earlier reinstatement entries on the membership:

| Earlier reinstatement entries on the membership | Surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 100 |
| Exactly one | 50 |
| None | None |

**Question: when is the surcharge applied?** It is added to the fee to pay once every amount taken off it has been taken off, and it is never itself reduced.

**Question: what counts as an earlier reinstatement?** Any reinstatement entry already on the membership's activity, whichever forfeiture it undid.

**Hypothetical cases.** A membership with one earlier reinstatement entry adds 50 USD; one with three earlier entries adds 100 USD; one with none adds nothing.
